title: Persistence Load Failure
acceptance: A pure SessionLockRules.loadFailure(err, developmentPlace) returns memory only for DataStore-unavailable errors in a development place (Studio or PlaceId 0); everything else, and every error on a live server, is retry.

PlayerDataService uses it for load errors and for GetDataStore failures: a live server never enters memory mode; after bounded retries the player is readonly (existing banner) and no default profile is ever saved over real data.
Specs cover development and live cases; a negative control (the old behaviour) fails the live spec.
Studio memory mode is unchanged: FullLoop passes in an unpublished place; scripts/check.sh passes.

history.note: audit passed; merge needs human approval
